summary: The run is at its total-time limit and the retained work is complete, so this turn adds nothing new and resubmits the current record. Final state: one asserted defect, established with ten receipts and confined by five independent controls. A voter dropped from both halves of the configuration and then re-admitted keeps its proposal gate disarmed while it observes no leader change, so Propose and ProposeConfChange calls from that member never return, never deliver and raise no error until the caller's own deadline or an unrelated leader change, at which point the held request is admitted unmodified and its payload commits; the member remains a voter that knows a healthy leader, keeps serving read-index completions, and still participates in replication and application, while a never-removed member, an outgoing voter of a joint configuration that is never left, and the same member after a leader change all behave normally. Supporting records: a randomized safety exploration with membership changes injected reporting zero violations in two seeds of 300 steps with its scope and its deliberately unsampled restart combination stated, two retained resynchronization branches covering catch-up from the log tail and from a snapshot, and a removed-leader step-down control under StepDownOnRemoval. Every question is answered and every interpretation carries its counterevidence, limits and exact receipt indices; the generated harness passes all seven of its probes locally, and the fifteen fixed artifacts remain exactly as the recorded executions used them.
